title: Attendant of Light
summary: Defeating a dragorn sycophant can call the Attendant of Light and a group of discordling harassers.
overview: Defeating a dragorn sycophant can call the Attendant of Light and a group of discordling harassers.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The ritual begins with eight sycophants around the spawner. A sycophant death summons the Attendant if one is not already present.
Four discordling harassers appear with the Attendant. Prepare to control the escort enemies when triggering the boss.
The spawner tracks all eight sycophant deaths separately; killing all eight is not required by the Attendant’s spawn condition.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
